source.bar_text: Prominentestes Kiachnobahapt is da Franz ois Papst vo da remisch-katholischn Kiachn, den de ondonan Kiachgmoaschoftn oba net ois des ihrige Obahapd onakenna.

Bavarian text:
Prominentestes Kiachnobahapt is da Franz ois Papst vo da remisch-katholischn Kiachn, den de ondonan Kiachgmoaschoftn oba net ois des ihrige Obahapd onakenna.

translation: The most prominent head of the church is Franz as Pope of the Roman Catholic Church, whom the other church communities, however, do not recognize as their head.
